newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Man crushed to death in Australia coal mine.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Man crushed to death in Australia coal mine.

text.p: A 27-year-old man was crushed to death at Australia's Dartbrook underground coal mine in the New South Wales Hunter Valley region on Monday when a roof collapsed on him, the mine's operator, Shell Australia Ltd said.
The man, whose name was not released, was killed at 0220 GMT (1.20 p.m.), a spokeswoman for Shell said.
The mine would remain closed for 24 hours out of respect for the dead man, the spokeswoman said.
An investigation into the death would be launched shortly, she said.
The dead man was employed by Tecrete Industries, a construction company, the spokeswoman said.
The mine is 75 percent owned by Shell Australia Ltd, a wholly-owned subsidiary of Royal Dutch/Shell Group.
The other owners are Marubeni Corp 15 percent, Ssanyong, seven percent and Showa Coal, three percent.
Last year it produced about four million tonnes of thermal coal.
